proves.claim: add --after-gate files an item whose after list and after-gate list both hold the id, and edit --after-gate none clears only the gate list.

cli.commands-add.after-gate.why: The flag is the one door to the after-gate list the store already keeps.

proves.claim: A plain add --after leaves the after-gate list empty.

cli.commands-add.after-plain.why: A plain wait must never read as a gate wait.

proves.claim: show prints an after-gate line naming the ids for an item filed with --after-gate.

cli.commands-show.after-gate-line.why: A reader of show must see which waits come from the gate list.

proves.claim: show prints no after-gate line for an item filed with a plain --after.

cli.commands-show.no-after-gate-line.why: The line appears only when the list is not empty.
